commander.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
commander.notes: This colorless deck seems to very quickly run out of interesting cards on budget. At the moment, there are single digits of enchantments, planeswalkers and battles. There are less than thirty instants and sorceries in total. Eldrazi are now colored and there is barely enough colorless monsters to fill the deck. They are moving away from colorless artifacts so we will have to use older and common subset of available cards. For now, I think there is nothing wrong with just rebuilding Eldrazi Unbound and proxying expensive Eldrazi.
